body_markdown:
This article explains how to troubleshoot issues if your MyKad Reader is not working.


**Issue #1:** ‘No reader detected’ at dashboard


**Troubleshooting steps:**


1. Check USB connection for Mykad Reader. You may unplug and replug the USB Connection.


2. Ensure Yezza Hardware program is opened & running at background.
Download latest Yezza Hardware[here](https://cdn.yezza.io/desktop-client/yezza-hardware-setup-v240822.exe) .


**Issue #2:** Yezza Hardware detects the IC, but it does not appear at dashboard


**Troubleshooting steps:**


1. Ensure company name appears at Yezza Hardware.


If your company name is missing, do log out and re-login.


If there is not log-out button, you may uninstall the Yezza Hardware, and re-install latest[here](https://cdn.yezza.io/desktop-client/yezza-hardware-setup-v240822.exe) .


**Issue #3:** Yezza Hardware is not responding


**Troubleshooting steps:**


1. Close the Yezza Hardware program.


2. Ensure Mykad reader is connected to USB.


3. Reopen Yezza Hardware.
